posts.author: Hellenabe
posts.paraphrase: Opening post. They have decided against rucksacks because they think rucksacks look bulky on them; want a stylish bag for a 15-inch laptop to replace an old baby changing bag; coat is light blue so considering grey, white, brown or black.
posts.quote: Having decided against rucksacks as I think they look bulky on me

posts.author: FanSpamTastic
posts.paraphrase: They own a Mia Tui bag; say it is a good size and the shoulder straps are a good length, comfortable even over a coat. Linked the product.
posts.quote: It's a good size and the shoulder straps are a good length

posts.author: sittingonacornflake
posts.quote: Also here to recommend Mia tui!

posts.author: Starseeed
posts.paraphrase: They use a basic black Radley tote (on sale, linked) that fits plenty; the laptop feels heavy on their shoulder, so they carry a separate handheld handbag for personal items and keep the tote for work only. Asks whether OP wants a shoulder or handheld bag.
posts.quote: I find a laptop heavy on my shoulder, so I take another hand held handbag for my personal bits

posts.author: Hellenabe
posts.paraphrase: They like the Mia Tui lining and ask whether it looks like leather; think a shoulder tote would hurt their shoulder and prefer a nice handheld bag; plan a separate thread for a non-work bag.
posts.quote: I like the idea of a nice handheld one if im honest.

posts.author: FanSpamTastic
posts.paraphrase: They say the Mia Tui is not real leather but is soft and does not feel plastic.
posts.quote: it's not real leather but does not feel plastic - it's soft like leather.

posts.author: MuthaHubbard
posts.paraphrase: They recommend a Radley zip-top laptop bag (linked) their partner bought them a couple of years ago; it fits their laptop, purse and other items well. Only found it at one retailer.
posts.quote: DH bought me this one a couple of years ago and fits my laptop, purse and bits and bobs perfectly

posts.author: Koala2
posts.paraphrase: They have a Roka London Bantry B, which they describe as a non-bulky rucksack (linked).
posts.quote: I have a Roka London bantry B, which is a non-bulky rucksack.

posts.author: ElizabethinherGermanGarden
posts.paraphrase: They also had the Mia Tui but found it very heavy even when empty, its main downside. Now use an M&S zip-up leather tote, not designed for laptops, which fits a small laptop kept in a slim sleeve for protection.
posts.quote: It was very heavy, even without anything in it.

posts.author: Hellenabe
posts.paraphrase: They worry a rucksack would make them look hunched because of a large bust, though they like the style; ask for the M&S link; find Radley old-fashioned but like MuthaHubbard's bag.
posts.quote: I worry I'll look a bit hunchback style as I have a big bust!

posts.author: NphysT
posts.paraphrase: They own a black Anna Field briefcase (linked), love it, have had lots of compliments on it and say it is not bulky.
posts.quote: Had lots of compliments on it and it's not bulky or anything.

posts.author: Blueberrymood
posts.paraphrase: They say they damaged their shoulder from years of carrying a heavy laptop on one shoulder; suggest slim rucksacks that can be carried either way: Nordace Siena, Sandqvist Tony Vegan, a more compact Antler Chelsea backpack, and Doughnut as a cheaper option (all linked).
posts.quote: I've nackered my shoulder from years of carrying a heavy lap top on one shoulder.

posts.author: Blueberrymood
posts.paraphrase: They say Knomo bags are lovely and very compact but expensive.
posts.quote: Knomo are also lovely and very compact but they are quite spendy.

posts.author: JustFrustrated
posts.paraphrase: They own a Carter Bags laptop tote in fawn (also in black), vegan leather from recycled plastic; praise the company (a single-parent business), the packaging, easy cleaning, and the thick strap that stays easy to carry when the bag is full and heavy. Posted photos.
posts.quote: The thick strap means that even when it's full and heavy, it's easy to carry.

posts.author: ElizabethinherGermanGarden
posts.paraphrase: They link the M&S black leather tote closest to their own, slightly more expensive than the one they bought in autumn.
posts.quote: This is the closest to what I have, although its slightly more expensive than the one I bought in the autumn.

posts.author: Hellenabe
posts.paraphrase: They like Blueberrymood's rucksack suggestion but still find rucksacks bulky; the Anna Field is more their style but they worry it may look dated.
posts.quote: The Anna Field looks more my style but again I worry ill look dated

posts.author: Hellenabe
posts.paraphrase: Months later they are still searching for a bag because their baby bag has fallen apart; no purchase decision recorded.
posts.quote: Still bag hunting as my baby bag has fallen apart
